summary: Integra Resources Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing a NI 43-101 technical report for its Florida Canyon Gold Mine in Nevada, dated July 28, 2026 (effective May 31, 2026), and a related news release. The filing discloses mineral resource and reserve estimates, forward-looking statements on mine operations, expansion plans, and economics. It is a routine regulatory disclosure of technical and operational data, not a special-situation corporate event such as a merger, divestiture, or strategic review. The role is that of the issuer providing an update to US regulators and security holders.
